svg.text: Example I: GSEA names the programme; the leading-edge heatmap names the genes.
GSEA: interferon-α response, patients vs controls
genes ranked by the patient-vs-control statistic
rows: leading-edge genes in rank order, named
columns: one per sample, grouped, n shown
patient 6 barely responds; you see it because
every sample has its own column
✅ Caption: "Patients show an interferon-α response (NES 2.4, FDR < 0.001), led by IFI44L, ISG15 and MX1 (n = 6 vs 6)."
⚠️ The genes in b were chosen by the GSEA, so b will always look split. It shows which genes drive the score;
the evidence that the groups differ is the NES and FDR in a.
